>

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 118

**Price** 12 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Cast a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Tawny-colored [hippogriff](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3052) feathers can be up to 2 feet long. Used as a catalyst with a [_ghostly carrier_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1543) spell, a single _hippogriff feather_ grants the hand semicorporeal wings that increase the hand's maneuverability. The hand has a range of only 60 feet, but its increased agility grants it a +1 status bonus to its AC and Reflex saves.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
